messages:
Maya: Quick sweep — we need to finalize RCAX-2026 closure runbook assignments and due dates today. I pasted the current action list below, please ack or reassign with a date.

Maya: Actions: 
- A1: Add graceful fallback for model routing (was assigned to Chris) — currently open
- A2: Add missing audit logs for private deploys (Priya) — partial work in PR
- A3: Canary plan for Dedicated capacity rollback (Dan) — doc draft exists
- A4: Update runbook with SLA escalation steps (unassigned)

Chris: Ack A1. I can finish the fallback in the next 48h but need a day to validate perf. Propose due: 2026-07-22. :white_check_mark:

Priya: For A2 I pushed a PR but it needs QA from security. Can we set due 2026-07-24? Tagging @security for a quick review.

Dan: A3 — I can own the canary rollback plan. I want to include a fallback to the smaller-quantized model and a traffic split test. Due 2026-07-21. Will add checklist to the doc.

Maya: A4 — I can draft the SLA escalation steps today and assign to ops for review. Proposed due 2026-07-20.

Priya: Request: can we move A2 to 2026-07-26 if security needs time? no blocker from infra but prefer safety window.

Chris: 2026-07-22 still okay for me. If Priya needs A2 later, we should note dependency: A4 must be in place before A2 is closed (audit step references escalation flow).

Dan: Noted dependency. I can sequence the canary doc so the runbook references the SLA items.

ops-bot: Reminder created: RCAX-2026 follow-ups (A1,A2,A3,A4) — due notifications scheduled: 2026-07-20, 2026-07-21, 2026-07-22, 2026-07-24.

Maya: Sounds good. Finalized timeline (subject to Priya):
```
A4 - SLA escalation doc — Maya — due 2026-07-20
A3 - Canary rollback plan — Dan  — due 2026-07-21
A1 - Model routing fallback — Chris — due 2026-07-22
A2 - Audit logs PR + security review — Priya — due 2026-07-24/26 (TBD)
```

Maya: Please confirm by EOD that these dates work or drop a suggested date. I'll update the issue tracker and the postmortem checklist after confirmation. :calendar:
